mapper.insert:
insert into goods_orders
order_no, order_status, order_time, quantity, total_price, user_id, shop_id, goods_id, goods_name, goods_img, goods_price, address_id, consignee, phone_number, province_code, city_code, district_code, detail_address,
#{orderNo}, #{orderStatus}, #{orderTime}, #{quantity}, #{totalPrice}, #{userId}, #{shopId}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsName}, #{goodsImg}, #{goodsPrice}, #{addressId}, #{consignee}, #{phoneNumber}, #{provinceCode}, #{cityCode}, #{districtCode}, #{detailAddress},
mapper.select: select id, order_no, order_status, order_time, quantity, total_price, user_id, shop_id, goods_id, goods_name, goods_img, goods_price, address_id, consignee, phone_number, province_code, city_code, district_code, detail_address from goods_orders where order_no = #{orderNo}

select go.id, go.order_no, go.order_status, go.order_time, go.quantity, go.total_price, go.user_id, go.shop_id, go.goods_id, go.goods_name, go.goods_img, go.goods_price, go.address_id, go.consignee, go.phone_number, go.province_code, go.city_code, go.district_code, go.detail_address, u.nickname as userNickname, ps.nickname as shopName from goods_orders go left join user u on go.user_id = u.id left join pet_shop ps on go.shop_id = ps.id where go.id = #{id}

select go.order_no, go.order_status, go.order_time, go.quantity, go.total_price, go.shop_id, go.goods_name, go.goods_img, go.goods_price, ps.nickname as shopName from goods_orders go left join pet_shop ps on go.shop_id = ps.id where go.user_id = #{userId} order by go.order_time desc
select coalesce(sum(total_price), 0) from goods_orders where order_status != 5
select ps.nickname as shopName, sum(go.total_price) as amount from goods_orders go left join pet_shop ps on go.shop_id = ps.id where go.order_status != 5 group by go.shop_id

select status_list.status, coalesce(count(go.id), 0) as count, coalesce(sum(go.total_price), 0) as amount from (select 0 as status union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5) as status_list left join goods_orders go on status_list.status = go.order_status and go.shop_id = #{shopId} and date(go.order_time) = curdate() group by status_list.status order by status_list.status;
